thread:
Leah Morgan: Quick sync — putting together the final copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing sections plus the companion launch posts and webinar sign-up. Goal: single-page clarity so visitors immediately find the path they need. Drafts in Drive: https://drive.google.com/mock-landing-2
Theo Rivera: Love that. High-level voice: Hosted = "start instantly", Dedicated = "reserved performance", Private = "control & compliance". But let's avoid repeated words. Maybe Hosted: 'spin up in minutes', Dedicated: 'capacity you can count on', Private: 'deploy inside your network'.
Grace Kim: CTA suggestions: Hosted -> "Try the API" (opens instant trial), Dedicated -> "Reserve capacity" (leads AE flow), Private -> "Schedule a private demo". Each CTA should set form fields for routing.
Omar Hassan: Routing map proposal — keeping it minimal:
```
/landing?mode=hosted  -> hub-form: trial-hosted, utm=launch23-hosted
/landing?mode=dedicated -> hub-form: lead-dedicated (fields: qps, concurrency, commit-size)
/landing?mode=private -> hub-form: enterprise-sales (fields: compliance, onprem?)
/webinar/register -> nurture-webinar-llm-scale
```
Add a hidden utm_source=launch_posts for analytics.
Nora Patel: For webinar gating: add "Are you evaluating for production?" and "Do you need SOC2 / FedRAMP?" If either yes -> add to Private sales queue. Also include a checkbox "I'd like a follow-up capacity estimate" to tag Dedicated leads.
Leah Morgan: Great. Marketing social cadence idea: Day 0 hero + 3 micro-benchmarks (latency, throughput, cost); Day 1 short customer-run (internal app) highlight; Day 3 webinar reminder. Need snappy 140-char variants for X.
Theo Rivera: I can draft three X variants per product row. Also recommend an image treatment: small benchmark sparkline for Hosted, capacity heatmap for Dedicated, a network lock for Private. Visual ops: can we get assets by Tue?
Grace Kim: Microcopy tweaks:
- Hosted hero subline: "API access in minutes — ideal for prototypes and production pilots."
- Dedicated subline: "Reserved GPU pools with predictable latency and autoscale bursts."
- Private subline: "Private deployment (VPC / on-prem) with KMS & audit logs."
Avoid the word "fastest" without benchmark proof.
Omar Hassan: Benchmarks — I'll export p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, and cost-per-1k from infra dashboards. We should show baseline vs an open-quantized config and note the test model/seq-length. I'll attach a one-line methodology under each benchmark card.
Nora Patel: For forms: Dedicated should include a quick dropdown for expected model families (e.g., small/med/large) and expected peak tokens/sec. That will help sizing before AE reachout. Also include a budget range field for prioritization.
Leah Morgan: Action items:
- Theo: 3 social X/LinkedIn copy sets + image notes (due Mon)
- Omar: benchmark exports + one-line methodology per variant (due Mon)
- Grace: finalize hero/subline microcopy + CTAs (due Mon)
- Nora: Hub form fields + SFDC routing doc (due Tue)
- Marketing ops: implement hidden utm and form routing (due Wed)
I'll collate and open a PR for the landing copy once we have CTAs locked.
Grace Kim: One more note — on the public page, label "Private deployment (VPC / on-prem)" everywhere to reduce confusion. Also add a short footnote about compliance packages (SOC2, HIPAA, FedRAMP) linking to our compliance page.
Theo Rivera: I'll also prepare A/B copy for the Dedicated CTA: "Estimate monthly capacity" vs "Reserve capacity" to test conversion.
Omar Hassan: Ping me if benchmarks need narrowing to a single run spec. Otherwise I'll deliver graphs + raw numbers.
Leah Morgan: Thanks team — scheduling a 25m async check Thu. Post any blockers here.
